mentions.name: Ensō
mentions.description: Ensō is a writing app for flow/stream-of-consciousness writing. The current release adds support for non-Latin scripts, especially RTL languages (Arabic, Persian, Hebrew), plus pinyin and Japanese input methods, and ships with a custom font made for the app. The author is also organizing notes on how different user groups use the app.
mentions.audience: Script writers and other flow-writing users; the author also mentions user groups including mental health focused users, neurodivergent users, and bloggers.
mentions.source_excerpt: Ensō: my writing app for flow/stream of consciousness writing. So, I'm wrapping up the release and adding good support for non-Latin, esp. RTL languages (Arabic, Persian, Hebrew) + pinyin and Japanese input methods.
